title: Pentacles in tarot: court card meanings
description: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how court cards can be people, aspects of yourself or approaches.

scenes.headline: Pentacles in tarot: court card meanings
scenes.caption: The Pentacles court cards show four practical temperaments, from the learning Page to the experienced King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.
scenes.vo: The Pentacles court cards show four practical temperaments, from the learning Page to the experienced King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.

scenes.headline: Page of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Study, curiosity about the practical, a first step. The Page stands in a green field, gazing at a single pentacle held carefully.
scenes.vo: Page of Pentacles. Study, curiosity about the practical, a first step. The Page stands in a green field, gazing at a single pentacle held carefully.

scenes.headline: Knight of Pentacles
scenes.caption: Reliability, patience, steady progress. The Knight is usually shown on a still horse, holding a pentacle and looking at it closely.
scenes.vo: Knight of Pentacles. Reliability, patience, steady progress. The Knight is usually shown on a still horse, holding a pentacle and looking at it closely.
